_doc: G350 (RK3326). Image names, src offsets/sizes (sfdisk -d <image>), dtb paths and uuids are tied to specific image releases: re-check them when an image is updated.
name: G350
_key_pins: Vol-, Vol+ (GPIO2_A1, GPIO2_A0); also the order keys are handed out
_boot: first matching rule wins. ini: dArkOS's Hardkernel U-Boot 2017.09 runs boot.ini. scr-g350: ROCKNIX's mainline U-Boot runs boot.scr (the Hardkernel U-Boot crashes ROCKNIX's mainline kernel).
_src: partitions copied from each image, in order: [start, size, what] in sectors

knulli: FAT KNULLI 3G; its ext4 p2 is replaced by SHARE

_dtb: from each OS's boot.ini / extlinux.conf. ArkOS's own rk3326-rg351mp-linux.dtb drives the G350 panel wrong (white, then yellow screen; tested): it gets dArkOS's dtb, same 4.4.189 kernel tree.
_uuids: filesystem UUIDs inside the images (checked after flashing; AmberELEC and ROCKNIX boot by them)
_os_opts: per-OS settings for this device's images
_os_boot_ini: OSes whose own BOOT partition gets src/boot.ini.<os> (reference only; U-Boot reads p1)
_numbers: roles on the --plan Numbers: line; later groups only when their first role exists
_untested: per boot mode: OSes not yet booted on a device that way (--plan warns)
